sources.entry: horita - Menu bar app that counts down to your next meeting and joins Zoom, Meet and Teams calls in one click.

summary.one_liner: horita is a small macOS menu bar app that counts down to your next calendar meeting and joins Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams calls with one click.
summary.what_it_does: It reads the calendars already set up on your Mac and shows a countdown in the menu bar only when a meeting is close, with the threshold set by you. Clicking the icon opens a dropdown with the rest of today's meetings, and hovering a meeting shows its location, organizer and attendees. A daily summary line gives meeting count, busy time and free time, and it marks overlapping or back-to-back meetings. Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams links are detected automatically, and a keyboard shortcut can join the next call. Optional reminders (banner or full-screen with Join, Snooze and Dismiss) are off by default, and a setting hides meeting titles while screen sharing. Google accounts can be connected directly in Settings, with tokens stored in the Keychain.
use_cases: see the next meeting at a glance from the menu bar
join a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams call in one click
check how busy today is and when you are free
get meeting reminders before calls start
hide meeting titles while sharing screen
connect a work Google calendar on a Mac
how_to_run: Download horita for Mac and open the DMG
Drag horita into Applications and open it
Allow calendar access when macOS asks
Or install with: brew install --cask cordwainersmith/tap/horita
notable: Menu bar countdown that appears only when a meeting is near
Daily summary line with busy and free time and overlap marking
Can connect Google accounts directly, separate from macOS Calendar
Hides meeting titles for screen sharing
caveats: Detects only Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams; README points to MeetingBar for Webex or Discord
Checks for new versions online via dl.horita.app with anonymous counts
